errors.message: Calling apache_setenv() is forbidden, might overwrite existing variables.
Calling dl() is forbidden, removed from most SAPIs, might load untrusted code.
Calling eval() is forbidden, eval is evil, please write more code and do not use eval().
Calling extract() is forbidden, do not use extract() and especially not on untrusted data.
Calling posix_getpwuid() is forbidden, might reveal system user information.
Calling posix_kill() is forbidden, do not send signals to processes from the script.
Calling posix_mkfifo() is forbidden, do not create named pipes in the script.
Calling posix_mknod() is forbidden, do not create special files in the script.
Calling highlight_file() is forbidden, might reveal source code or config files.
Calling show_source() is forbidden, might reveal source code or config files (alias of highlight_file()).
Calling pfsockopen() is forbidden, use fsockopen() to create non-persistent socket connections.
Calling print_r() is forbidden, use some logger instead.
Calling print_r() is forbidden, use some logger instead.
Calling proc_nice() is forbidden, changes the priority of the current process.
Calling putenv() is forbidden, might overwrite existing variables.
Calling socket_create_listen() is forbidden, do not accept new socket connections in the PHP script.
Calling socket_listen() is forbidden, do not accept new socket connections in the PHP script.
Calling var_dump() is forbidden, use some logger instead.
Calling var_export() is forbidden, use some logger instead.
Calling var_export() is forbidden, use some logger instead.
Calling phpinfo() is forbidden, might reveal session id or other tokens in cookies.
errors.tip: see https://www.michalspacek.com/stealing-session-ids-with-phpinfo-and-how-to-stop-it and use e.g. spaze/phpinfo instead
